The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `3306` (see `MySqlBuilder.MySqlPort`)
- Environment variable: `MYSQL_DATABASE=test` (see `MySqlBuilder.WithDatabase(string)`)
- Environment variable: `MYSQL_USER=mysql` (see `MySqlBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `MYSQL_PASSWORD=mysql` (see `MySqlBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Environment variable: `MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=mysql` (see `MySqlBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the `mysql` client runs `SELECT 1;` successfully.
